text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, Mejiro Dober invites me to an
event for
making wet potpourri, a type
of interior
fragrance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I know she loves herbs, so I want to do
my best to
support her efforts to create
a great fragrance!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Come on. This isn't the kind of event you need to be getting that enthusiastic about.
choice_data_list: さあ、どのハーブを摘めばいいんだ？
さあ、どのハーブを摘めばいい？

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, calm down, Trainer. You don't
need to
bring that kind of enthusiasm to
this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, we have been
walking for
quite a while... I'd like to
take a short break. You
sit down too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
We've been walking for quite a
while—are you
getting tired? I brought
some herbal tea, so let's
take a break.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...I brought some chocolate, so you
should eat
some. Don't want you passing
out on me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I also have some chocolate and other
snacks!
We're going to be doing a lot
more walking, so
you should stock up on
energy.
choice_data_list: けど、イベントは？
けど、イベントは？

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
The event runs until this evening. Let's
head over
to that shaded area. Hurry up.
choice_data_list: けど、イベントは？
けど、イベントは？

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry! The event runs until this
evening.
Let's rest in that shaded area.
Come, this way!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Won over by Mejiro Dober's rare show of

forcefulness, I accept her kind
hospitality.
Afterwards, it's finally time
to gather the herbs.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Won over by Mejiro Dober's rare show of

forcefulness, I accept her kind
hospitality.
Afterwards, it's finally time
to gather the herbs.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Oh, there's some rosemary over there...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I wonder, though. Rosemary would be
refreshing and
revitalizing, but I feel like
something would still be
lacking.
choice_data_list: じゃあ、あれを摘もうか？

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Then maybe I have my priorities
backwards. Yes, it's
probably better to
go with a different herb...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It's nothing! Anyway, we're holding off
on the
rosemary for now. Let's search
over there.
choice_data_list: もしもし？

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Oh, um, it's nothing. Anyway, let's put
the
rosemary on hold for now. We
should try over
there instead, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
If we climb this cliff, I'm sure we'll find
other herbs
up there!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Well, I need some muña! And that herb
grows on
high ground.
choice_data_list: こ、この崖を登る！？

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
They're great for health and promote
relaxation!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite telling me not to get excited
about this
event, she seems strangely
eager... Regardless,
we continue
collecting herbs.
choice_data_list: ケガをしたら健康どころじゃないぞ……！
ケガをしたら健康どころじゃないよ……！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober contacts me a few days
later to let
me know that the wet
potpourri is ready. I guess
she wants to
show me, since I helped a little?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Here. This is the wet potpourri from
the other
day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Here. It's the wet potpourri I made the
other day!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
What? You don't want it? I'd like to
think I did a
pretty good job with it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Don't you want it? It smells great,
and I'm
quite proud of how it turned out,
actually...
choice_data_list: え！？こ、これ君のじゃ……
え！？こ、これ貴方のじゃ……

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
No, I've already got a bunch of these
anyway.
choice_data_list: え！？こ、これ君のじゃ……
え！？こ、これ貴方のじゃ……

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hm? I don't think I remember saying
that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You see... I got a call from my former
trainer not
too long ago.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...To tell you the truth, I got a call from
my former
trainer not too long ago.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It's been so long since we've spoken! To
what do I
owe this pleasure?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It's been so long since we've spoken! To
what do I
owe this pleasure?

text_block_list.name: Dober's Former Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I just wanted to see how you've been
doing lately.
You're not pushing yourself
too hard, are you? I
hope you're getting
proper rest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm getting plenty of rest, I assure you! I
even
attended a Mejiro family tea party
recently.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I really am doing fine... Well, I am, anyway...

text_block_list.name: Dober's Former Trainer
text_block_list.text: ...Berry?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
No, forget it! It's nothing. I'm completely
fine!

text_block_list.name: Dober's Former Trainer
text_block_list.text: Okay, then... Can I tell you something?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: S-sure...

text_block_list.name: Dober's Former Trainer
text_block_list.text:
You're kinder than you realize, Berry.
You really
do care about others.

text_block_list.name: Dober's Former Trainer
text_block_list.text:
So have more faith in that kindness. If
you do, I'm
sure you'll be able to handle
any challenge that
comes your way.

text_block_list.name: Dober's Former Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Keep giving it your best. I'm
rooting for
you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...R-right! Thank you very much for the
call.
Goodbye.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...You're always worrying about me, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, I know you worry about me a

lot—you're always making sure I rest
properly and
whatnot.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
And I couldn't just sit by on the
receiving end
forever...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
So I... I wanted to do a little something
for you in
return.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Back when we were collecting herbs, she
was
pushing herself while telling me to
take it easy... I
guess it was all for my
sake...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Back when we were collecting herbs, she
was
pushing herself while telling me to
take it easy... I
guess it was all for my
sake...
choice_data_list: 俺のために、ありがとう
私のために、ありがとう

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! I-I never said it was for you! It's
just...
there's someone special to me I
didn't want to let
down!
choice_data_list: 俺のために、ありがとう
私のために、ありがとう

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm the one who should be grateful
to you.
Thank you for always holding me
dear.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Besides... we won't be winning any races
unless
we're both at our best.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad that you like it. It feels like I
finally got
to return the favor somewhat.

これからも一緒に頑張っていこうね

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I went to a lot of effort making that
potpourri, so
I expect as much effort
from you.
choice_data_list: これからも一緒に頑張っていこうな
これからも一緒に頑張っていこうね

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Right! I'm expecting great things!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You better not slack off while you're
indulging in
that fragrance, though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
We'll ace tomorrow's training with
aplomb, then
keep riding that
momentum!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It's fine. If you keep doing that, there'll
be no end
to this.

text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.text:
W-wait... Um, what... What do you
mean?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Don't use such ambiguous phrasing.

text_block_list.text: Oh... Ohhh! But come on, why say that now? I know that's how you've always done things!

text_block_list.text:
...Well, if you do want to do something
in return, I
won't stop you.

text_block_list.text:
...You threw me for a loop there. I
